value.summary: Lando NORRIS (NOR) is the overall better driver, edging out Max VERSTAPPEN (VER) with a race-pace advantage of 1.385 s per lap (86.399 s vs 87.784 s) and a peak-pace edge of 1.461 s (84.696 s vs 86.157 s). He also out-qualifies VER by 1.178 places (3.929 places vs 5.107 places) and finishes on average 0.293 places ahead (3.667 places vs 3.96 places). VER does win the overtaking and positions-gained battles, with 5.107 overtakes versus 4.464 and 1.08 places gained versus 0.167. The comparison is limited by the fact that NOR did not finish five of the 28 races and VER missed four, which drags down both drivers’ result and pace averages.
